title: With Vendor Order Management View only, a new return cannot be started
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that can start vendor returns.
  • {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RETVIEWONLY) is a staff member at {Location-A} whose custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RETVIEWONLY) has 'Vendor Order Management → View' and not 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit'.
  • {User-B} is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser or a private window.
custom_steps:
1. As the Admin, go to Parts → Returns.
  2. Click the control that starts a new return.
  3. As {User-B}, go to Parts → Returns.
  4. Look for the same control and click it if it is there.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The "Create Return" page opens for the Admin. Note the control's label.
  • Step 3: The Returns list opens for {User-B}.
  • Step 4: {User-B} cannot start a vendor return: the control is not offered or is disabled, or using it is refused. Write in the result comment which one you saw.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-N3a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.6 (the "Create Return" page), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 10). SV-10822 does not yet carry S9-N3a (the PRD wins). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-N3a: “Opening Parts → Returns needs 'Vendor Order Management → View'. Starting a vendor return needs 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit'. A role with both and without 'Part Library & Inventory → View' opens a return and gets the S9-N3 access error when it searches for a part.”
